Biography.title: Biography
Biography.subtitle: Web Designer & Developer. Crafting distinctive digital experiences.
Biography.p1: I'm Parham Batouie, a web designer and developer working on creating and implementing digital experiences.
Biography.p2: My approach to web design combines modern aesthetics with precise technical structure. From UI design and page architecture to development and feature implementation, I strive to shape each project around its real identity and goals.
Biography.p3: In my workflow, I use web technologies and AI tools to improve development speed, evaluate solutions, and raise output quality.
